about_the_game:
After what felt like an eternity, the static from the radio crackled, delivering a chilling message: Nobody is coming. A cold fury surged through you, replacing the despair that had kept you a prisoner in inaction. You would not wait for a savior who would never arrive; you would become one.

This is survival horror in its purest form: tense, atmospheric, and unrelenting. Every last bit of resource is precious and every mistake brings you closer to death.

  • True Survival Horror Gameplay
    Navigate desolate streets and claustrophobic interiors, where danger lurks around every corner. Solve puzzles and face the terrors that will force a choice: fight, flee, or die.

  • Resource Scarcity and Tension
    Resources are scarce. Do you risk using your last bullet to take down a monster, or do you save it for a more critical moment and hope to slip past unnoticed?

  • Diegetic Grid-Based Inventory
    Every single item matters, and space is a luxury you can't afford. Carefully manage your limited inventory grid, making agonizing choices about what to carry and what to leave behind.

  • No HUD, No Distractions
    No health bars, no ammo counters, no intrusive menus. Every piece of information is conveyed through your character and the world around you. Your only interface is your own perception.

  • A Unique Weapon System
    Check your magazines manually, round by precious round, and reload with deliberate, step-by-step actions. Every firefight becomes a tense test of your nerves and skill.

  • A Bleak and Oppressive Atmosphere
    Rain-slick cobblestones and flickering fluorescent lights lead you deeper into a town that feels cold, hostile, and suffocating. The distant cries of things that should not exist echo through its desolate streets.

  • A Return to Forgotten Horror Traditions
    Fear comes from the atmosphere, the gnawing uncertainty, and the constant presence of death. The story is told through the environment itself, and combat is a slow, methodical dance where every shot matters.

short_description: In a cold, rainy Eastern Bloc town, you find yourself trapped in a room as abominations claw at your door, with nowhere to run. You must survive the feverish night, uncover the horrors lurking in the shadows and above all, find your wife Valeria.
